name: ZOOL
description: A calm, refined theme by ZOOL. Light and dark, four languages, live charts. 简约精致的 Komari 主题，支持明暗模式与多语言。
author: ZOOL

data.name: Default appearance · 默认外观
data.help: Used until a visitor picks one. 访客未选择时的外观。

data.name: Default home view · 默认首页视图
data.help: Ledger rows compare many nodes side by side; cards give each node its own block. Visitors can switch. 台账适合多节点逐行比对，卡片适合单节点浏览，访客可自行切换。

data.name: Ledger density · 台账密度
data.help: Row height of the node ledger. 节点台账的行高。

data.name: Default language · 默认语言
data.help: auto follows the visitor's browser. auto 跟随访客浏览器语言。

data.name: Site title override · 站点标题
data.help: Leave empty to use the site name from Komari settings. 留空则使用 Komari 设置里的站点名称。

data.name: Show monthly cost · 显示月度成本
data.help: Sums node prices per currency, normalised to 30 days. No exchange-rate lookups. 按币种合计并折算为 30 天，不请求任何汇率接口。

data.name: Offer the group filter · 提供分组筛选
data.help: Offer the group filter on the home page. When disabled, hide the control and never section by group, regardless of defaultGrouped. 在首页提供分组筛选控件。关闭时隐藏控件且始终不按分组分段，不受 defaultGrouped 影响。

data.name: Show by group by default · 「按分组展示」按钮默认开启
data.help: Default state of the visitor’s “Show by group” button. 访客的「按分组展示」按钮默认状态。

data.name: Show region filter · 显示地区筛选
Show price and expiry on cards · 卡片显示价格与到期
List offline nodes · 显示离线节点
Hidden nodes · 隐藏节点
data.help: Hidden from the home page, search and node switcher. 从首页、搜索与节点切换中隐藏。

data.name: Hide sign-in for visitors · 对访客隐藏登录入口
data.help: You can still open /admin directly. 仍可直接访问 /admin。
